fields.why: The Results compare HIV-testing percentages for Black and Hispanic vs White visits and for ages 20–29 vs younger or older, and the Table gives per-group percentages across 3 insurance types.
Sex is a pair, MSA status is the venue's location (and a pair), and region is geography; insurance type counts as SES under the brief.

Race (White referent) and age (20–29 vs the rest) claims are per-group vs referent; the CMH tests are period trends within each insurance level (rule F6, no entry) and no chi-square claim is made across insurance types, so side by side stands and the flag is a false alarm.
